name: solignition
description: Solignition monorepo root — Anchor program, frontend, deployer, landing, docs, generated clients

scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run codama:js
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SURFPOOL,BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green,yellow "npm run surfpool -- --no-tui" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n SURFPOOL,BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green,yellow "npm run surfpool" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test:full: concurrently -k -n SURFPOOL,ANCHOR_TEST -c blue,magenta "npm run surfpool" "wait-on tcp:8899 && npm run anchor-test"
scripts.setup: npm run anchor keys sync && npm run anchor build && npm run codama:js && npm run sync:anchor
